test.name: A single person's impossible dates route to check-warnings
test.description: Boundary against check-warnings. An event dated after a person's death is an impossibility in that person's own data -- it needs no source read at all, and check-warnings' person_warnings tool answers it deterministically. Reciprocal of the negative added under eval/tests/unit/check-warnings/ in the same change.

input.user_message: Ole C. Hole has a residence recorded in 1975 but he died in 1960. Can you check him for problems like that?

negative.explanation: An event after death is a contradiction in one person's own recorded data, which person_warnings detects offline without reading a single source. source-evaluation audits attached sources; it does not run impossibility checks, and its body routes this case to check-warnings before making any tool call.

judge_context: Should not enumerate or read the person's attached sources -- the question does not turn on what any source says
